vb_textbox.text: The max amount of mushrooms you can earn is 9, The way to tell which gnome will hold themost mushrooms is based on if it was lower than 3 when you select so start at random andthen choose red or brown if brown yeilds the highest potential stick with brown for a coupleof rotations until it drops below 3. The gnomes work in pairs so brown and purple/ red andgreen etc so once you find which of the colours holds the most amount of mushrooms stickwith that selection until both are below 3 mushrooms on collection and switch to the othercolours. I also found that the pairs don't always stay the same and will change after each turn which makes guessing the color with the most mushrooms harder but I found that when the color keeps changing, just pick either tall person or small person and if that person holds 7 or more mushroom, keep choosing that person, and it does not matter which color, just keep choosing that same person, but only do this when the colors keep changing each turn, otherwise do the strategy I mentioned at the start.
